description: This file defines a PHP class for handling customer report functionalities within the OpenCart admin extension. It includes methods for displaying the report form, saving configuration, listing customers, and generating report data, all adhering to the MVC architecture pattern used in OpenCart.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Controller class for managing customer reports in OpenCart admin extension, providing methods for report display, configuration saving, listing customers, and retrieving report data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the customer report form page, setting up breadcrumbs, page title, and loading necessary views.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving report configuration settings via POST request, with permission check and JSON response.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Generates the customer report page, loading report data, pagination, and rendering the report view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a JSON response with the customer report list data.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves filtered customer report data based on request parameters, including date range, grouping, pagination, and returns HTML view.
